# The Machine Anatomy {.unnumbered}

Every physical AI system acts through a body with limited capacity to move, stop, exert force, and dissipate heat. The first law of @sec-boundary-bedrock-laws holds that this apparatus cannot take back the work it delivers, and Part I turns that law into numbers. It asks how quickly the machine's evidence ages, how far the machine travels before it stops, how much torque its drives can deliver, and how much winding heat and supply-voltage drop they tolerate. The Body establishes what motion can be supported. The Brain, the learned proposer, establishes what computation can supply and how long its answers stay true. The Nervous System connects them within the time the stopping budget allows. This order lets the engineer derive an architectural requirement before selecting its implementation.

::: {#pri-vol4-irreversibility .callout-principle title="The irreversibility law"}

**Invariant**: Once a permitted command crosses the causal boundary, the energy it delivers becomes motion, strain, or heat that no software action can recall. At steady speed, during a pre-brake delay $\PrebrakeDelay$ the machine travels $\SpeedAtDetection\,\PrebrakeDelay$ before any response begins, so a stop requires $\StoppingDistance \le \ClearDistance$, with every term of $\StoppingDistance$ taken from a measured limit of this machine under stated conditions (@sec-body-kinetic-momentum).

**Implication**: Each part of the machine carries budgets in time, distance, torque, heat, and voltage. The checks needed to admit a command must finish before its execution and inside those budgets, and a design is admissible only when it can say which budget binds first, how that budget was established, and what the machine does when it is exhausted.

:::

* **The Physical Body (@sec-body):** Decides which physical budget binds first and how its value was established, and produces the limit record from which every later record descends.
* **The Cognitive Brain (@sec-brain):** Decides what a learned proposer can deliver on time and what memory and latency that costs, and derives the machine's two-speed split, a slow intent model above a fast chunk policy. It produces no record of its own; its proposer limits, and the payload every proposal must carry, enter the handoff record.
* **The Nervous System (@sec-nervous):** Decides where the permission path must run to stay independent of the proposer, how often it must check, and how long a proposal may drive the actuators, and produces the handoff record together with the header that every proposal carries. The independence it requires leads it to adopt a two-processor split as the hypothesis the machine is built on; whether that split holds on real silicon is decided in @sec-placement.

Part I hands forward three things. From @sec-body comes the limit record, the form in which every budget that can end in damage (measurement age, stopping distance, delivered torque, winding heat, and rail voltage) states its conditions and its category. The chapter fills that form on the machine for three limits, the credible deceleration behind the stopping distance, the drive torque that must deliver it, and the input lockout of the converter on the shared drive bus. From @sec-brain comes the proposer's supply, stated as how many future setpoints one chunk covers, how long a new chunk takes, and how quickly the evidence behind it ages, together with the reason a chunk keeps the arm supplied without keeping that evidence fresh. From @sec-nervous comes the handoff record: the lease the permission path derives from the stopping budget, the tick at which it checks, the handoffs between proposer and permission path, and a worked budget that couples all three chapters on the running machine. The example selects a candidate configuration; qualification still requires bounds on each interval, including dispatch to admission, evidence that the protective response remains physically available, and loaded tests showing that the permission path's isolation from the proposer holds. Part II inherits both records as preconditions on the demonstrations the machine collects while its permission path is watching.
